sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`
    ) AS TotalAssets,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`InstanceId` IS NOT NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithSourceCI,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`InstanceId` IS NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithoutSourceCI,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN PMV.`Product Name` IS NOT NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS CatalogMatchedAssets,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN PMV.`Product Name` IS NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS MissingCatalogAssets,

    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`) = 0
        THEN 0
        ELSE
            100.0 *
            COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN PMV.`Product Name` IS NOT NULL
                    THEN BE.`InstanceId`
                END
            ) /
            COUNT(
                DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`
            )
    END AS CatalogCoveragePct,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IN (
                'Normalized and Approved',
                'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                'Modified After Last Normalization',
                'Normalized but Not Approved'
            )
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS NormalizedAssets,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`InstanceId` IS NOT NULL
                AND (
                    SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IS NULL
                    OR SRC.`NormalizationStatus` NOT IN (
                        'Normalized and Approved',
                        'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                        'Modified After Last Normalization',
                        'Normalized but Not Approved'
                    )
                )
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS NotNormalizedAssets,

    CASE
        WHEN
            COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IN (
                        'Normalized and Approved',
                        'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                        'Modified After Last Normalization',
                        'Normalized but Not Approved'
                    )
                    THEN BE.`InstanceId`
                END
            )
            +
            COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN SRC.`InstanceId` IS NOT NULL
                        AND (
                            SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IS NULL
                            OR SRC.`NormalizationStatus` NOT IN (
                                'Normalized and Approved',
                                'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                                'Modified After Last Normalization',
                                'Normalized but Not Approved'
                            )
                        )
                    THEN BE.`InstanceId`
                END
            ) = 0
        THEN 0
        ELSE
            100.0 *
            COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IN (
                        'Normalized and Approved',
                        'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                        'Modified After Last Normalization',
                        'Normalized but Not Approved'
                    )
                    THEN BE.`InstanceId`
                END
            )
            /
            (
                COUNT(
                    DISTINCT CASE
                        WHEN SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IN (
                            'Normalized and Approved',
                            'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                            'Modified After Last Normalization',
                            'Normalized but Not Approved'
                        )
                        THEN BE.`InstanceId`
                    END
                )
                +
                COUNT(
                    DISTINCT CASE
                        WHEN SRC.`InstanceId` IS NOT NULL
                            AND (
                                SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IS NULL
                                OR SRC.`NormalizationStatus` NOT IN (
                                    'Normalized and Approved',
                                    'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                                    'Modified After Last Normalization',
                                    'Normalized but Not Approved'
                                )
                            )
                        THEN BE.`InstanceId`
                    END
                )
            )
    END AS NormalizationCoveragePct,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IN (
                'Normalized and Approved',
                'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                'Modified After Last Normalization',
                'Normalized but Not Approved'
            )
            AND PMV.`Product Name` IS NOT NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS FullyCoveredAssets,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IN (
                'Normalized and Approved',
                'Modified After Last Normalization',
                'Normalized but Not Approved'
            )
            AND PMV.`Product Name` IS NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS NormalizedNoCatalogMatch,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN PMV.`Product Name` IS NULL
                AND BE.`ManufacturerName` IS NOT NULL
                AND BE.`Model` IS NOT NULL
                AND BE.`VersionNumber` IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                BE.`ManufacturerName`
                + '|'
                + BE.`Model`
                + '|'
                + BE.`VersionNumber`
        END
    ) AS DistinctMissingProducts,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN BE.`ManufacturerName` IS NULL
                OR BE.`Model` IS NULL
                OR BE.`VersionNumber` IS NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS IncompleteProductData,

    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN BE.`ManufacturerName` IS NOT NULL
                AND BE.`Model` IS NOT NULL
                AND BE.`VersionNumber` IS NOT NULL
                AND PMV.`Product Name` IS NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS CatalogEntriesRequired

FROM `BMC.CORE:BMC_BaseElement` BE

LEFT OUTER JOIN `BMC.CORE:BMC_BaseElement` SRC
    ON SRC.`ReconciliationIdentity` = BE.`ReconciliationIdentity`
    AND SRC.`DatasetId` = 'BMC.ADDM'
    AND (
        SRC.`MarkAsDeleted` IS NULL
        OR SRC.`MarkAsDeleted` = 'No'
    )

LEFT OUTER JOIN `PCT:Product Model-Version` PMV
    ON PMV.`Product Name` = BE.`Model`
    AND PMV.`Manufacturer` = BE.`ManufacturerName`
    AND (
        PMV.`Product Model/Version` = BE.`VersionNumber`
        OR (
            PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
            AND BE.`VersionNumber` IS NULL
        )
    )

LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`ReconciliationIdentity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`

WHERE
    (${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True'
        OR (AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio))
    AND (
        ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships'
        OR AP.`PersonRole` = $Relationship
    ))
    AND BE.`DatasetId` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND (
        BE.`MarkAsDeleted` = 'No'
        OR BE.`MarkAsDeleted` IS NULL
    )

SELECT
    BE.`ClassId` AS CIClass,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`) >= 100
        THEN 'Critical'
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`) >= 50
        THEN 'High'
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`) >= 10
        THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS Priority,
    CASE
        WHEN BE.`ManufacturerName` IS NULL
        THEN 'Missing Manufacturer'
        WHEN BE.`Model` IS NULL
        THEN 'Missing Product'
        WHEN BE.`VersionNumber` IS NULL
        THEN 'Missing Version'
        WHEN PMV.`Product Name` IS NULL
        THEN 'No Catalog Match'
        ELSE 'Normalization Review'
    END AS Issue,
    CASE
        WHEN BE.`ManufacturerName` IS NULL
        THEN 'Missing'
        ELSE BE.`ManufacturerName`
    END AS Manufacturer,
    CASE
        WHEN BE.`Model` IS NULL
        THEN 'Missing'
        ELSE BE.`Model`
    END AS Product,
    CASE
        WHEN BE.`VersionNumber` IS NULL
        THEN 'Missing'
        ELSE BE.`VersionNumber`
    END AS Version,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`
    ) AS AffectedAssets,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`InstanceId` IS NOT NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithSourceCI,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`InstanceId` IS NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithoutSourceCI,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IN (
                'Normalized and Approved',
                'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                'Modified After Last Normalization',
                'Normalized but Not Approved'
            )
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS NormalizedAssets,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN SRC.`InstanceId` IS NOT NULL
                AND (
                    SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IS NULL
                    OR SRC.`NormalizationStatus` NOT IN (
                        'Normalized and Approved',
                        'Not Applicable For Normalization',
                        'Modified After Last Normalization',
                        'Normalized but Not Approved'
                    )
                )
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS NotNormalizedAssets,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN PMV.`Product Name` IS NOT NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS CatalogMatchedAssets,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN PMV.`Product Name` IS NULL
            THEN BE.`InstanceId`
        END
    ) AS MissingCatalogAssets,
    CASE
        WHEN BE.`ManufacturerName` IS NULL
        THEN 'Populate or normalize manufacturer'
        WHEN BE.`Model` IS NULL
        THEN 'Populate or normalize product name'
        WHEN BE.`VersionNumber` IS NULL
        THEN 'Populate or normalize product version'
        WHEN PMV.`Product Name` IS NULL
        THEN 'Create or update Product Catalog entry'
        ELSE 'Review source CI normalization'
    END AS RecommendedAction,
    SRC.`NormalizationStatus` AS NormalizationStatus
FROM `BMC.CORE:BMC_BaseElement` BE
LEFT OUTER JOIN `BMC.CORE:BMC_BaseElement` SRC
    ON SRC.`ReconciliationIdentity` = BE.`ReconciliationIdentity`
    AND SRC.`DatasetId` = 'BMC.ADDM'
    AND (
        SRC.`MarkAsDeleted` IS NULL
        OR SRC.`MarkAsDeleted` = 'No'
    )
LEFT OUTER JOIN `PCT:Product Model-Version` PMV
    ON PMV.`Product Name` = BE.`Model`
    AND PMV.`Manufacturer` = BE.`ManufacturerName`
    AND (
        PMV.`Product Model/Version` = BE.`VersionNumber`
        OR (
            PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'
            AND BE.`VersionNumber` IS NULL
        )
    )
LEFT OUTER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`ReconciliationIdentity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`
WHERE
    BE.`DatasetId` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND (
        BE.`MarkAsDeleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`MarkAsDeleted` = 'No'
    )
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
        OR (
            AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote})
            AND (
                ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships'
                OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}
            )
        )
    )
    AND (
    SRC.`InstanceId` IS NULL
    OR SRC.`NormalizationStatus` IS NULL
    OR SRC.`NormalizationStatus` NOT IN (
        'Normalized and Approved',
        'Not Applicable For Normalization',
        'Modified After Last Normalization',
        'Normalized but Not Approved'
    )
    OR (
        SRC.`NormalizationStatus` <> 'Not Applicable For Normalization'
        AND (
            BE.`ManufacturerName` IS NULL
            OR BE.`Model` IS NULL
            OR BE.`VersionNumber` IS NULL
            OR PMV.`Product Name` IS NULL
        )
    )
)
GROUP BY
    BE.`ClassId`,
    BE.`ManufacturerName`,
    BE.`Model`,
    BE.`VersionNumber`,
    PMV.`Product Name`,
    SRC.`NormalizationStatus`
ORDER BY
    COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`) DESC

panels.description: Restricted to assets within the portfolio and showing their matching product catalog entry where available

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT 
BE.`Manufacturer Name+` + ' ' + BE.`Model Number` + ' ' + BE.`Version Number` as CMDB_Product,
PMV.`Product Categorization Tier 1` AS Tier1,
PMV.`Product Categorization Tier 2` AS Tier2,
PMV.`Product Categorization Tier 3` AS Tier3,
PMV.`EndOfSupport` AS EndOfSupport,
PMV.`EndOfLife` AS EndOfLife,
PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport` AS EndOfExtendedSupport,
PMV.`Product Model/Version State` AS State,
PMV.`Market Version` AS MarketVersion,
PC.`Product ID`,
COUNT(BE.`Instance Id`) AS `NumberofCIs`
FROM
    `AST:BaseElement` BE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN`AST:AssetPeople` AP
          ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.AssetInstanceId
          LEFT OUTER JOIN `PCT:Product Catalog` PC
          ON BE.`Model Number` = PC.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PC.`Manufacturer`
             LEFT OUTER JOIN `PDL:ProductModelVersion` PMV
             ON BE.`Model Number` = PMV.`Product Name` AND BE.`Manufacturer Name+` = PMV.`Manufacturer` AND (BE.`Version Number` = PMV.`Product Model/Version` OR (PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN' AND BE.`Version Number` IS NULL))
WHERE 
(
BE.`Data Set Id` IN ('BMC.ASSET')
--and BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
        OR (
            AP.`Full Name` IN (${Portfolio:singlequote})
            AND (
                ${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships'
                OR AP.`PersonRole` = ${Relationship:singlequote}
            )
        )
    )
)
AND (BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No' OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` is null)

GROUP BY
`CMDB_Product`,
PMV.`Product Categorization Tier 1`,
PMV.`Product Categorization Tier 2`,
PMV.`Product Categorization Tier 3`,
PMV.`EndOfSupport`,
PMV.`EndOfLife`,
PMV.`EndOfExtendedSupport`,
PMV.`Product Model/Version State`,
PMV.`Market Version`,
PC.`Product ID`
ORDER BY
NumberofCIs desc

sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT   
 PMV.`Product Name` as `Product`,   
 PMV.`Manufacturer`,   
 PMV.`Product Model/Version` as `Version`,   
 BE.`EndOfLife` AS `BE_EndOfLife`,   
 PMV.`EndOfLife` AS `CAT_EndOfLife`,   
 BE.`EndOfSupport` AS `BE_EOS`,   
 PMV.`EndOfSupport` as `CAT_EOS`,
 BE.`NormalizationStatus` as `Normalization`,
 'Inconsistent' AS `Data_Issue`,
 COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`InstanceId`) as `InconsistentCIs`
 FROM `PCT:Product Model-Version` PMV   
 LEFT OUTER JOIN `BMC.CORE:BMC_BaseElement` BE   
  ON PMV.`Product Name` = BE.`Model`    
     AND PMV.`Manufacturer` = BE.`ManufacturerName`    
     AND (PMV.`Product Model/Version` = BE.`VersionNumber` OR (BE.`VersionNumber` IS NULL AND PMV.`Product Model/Version` = 'UNKNOWN'))   
 WHERE BE.`DatasetId` = 'BMC.ADDM' AND BE.`EndOfSupport` IS NOT NULL AND PMV.`EndOfSupport` <> BE.`EndOfSupport`
 GROUP BY PMV.`Product Name`, PMV.`Manufacturer`, PMV.`Product Model/Version`,
 BE.`EndOfLife`,   
 PMV.`EndOfLife`,   
 BE.`EndOfSupport`,   
 PMV.`EndOfSupport`,
 BE.`NormalizationStatus`
 order by `InconsistentCIs` desc
 LIMIT 25
